agency_urn.description: Specifies the uniform resource name of the trust agency to be assumed, in the format of iam::{account_id}:agency:{agency_name}.

assumed_agency.description: The information about the assumed agency session.

audience.description: The value of the Recipient attribute of the SubjectConfirmationData element in the SAML assertion.

duration_seconds.description: Specifies the validity period of the temporary security credentials, in seconds. The value ranges from 900 to 43200 and defaults to 3600.

idp_urn.description: The uniform resource name of the SAML identity provider.

issuer.description: The value of the Issuer element in the SAML assertion.

name_qualifier.description: The hash value of the issuer, the account ID and the name of the SAML identity provider.

policy.description: Specifies a custom policy in JSON format, which is used to further restrict the permissions of the temporary security credentials.

policy_ids.description: Specifies the list of preset policy IDs, which is used to restrict the permissions of the temporary security credentials. A maximum of 20 policy IDs can be configured.

provider_urn.description: Specifies the uniform resource name of the SAML identity provider, in the format of iam::{account_id}:samlProvider:{provider_name}.

saml_assertion.description: Specifies the base64 encoded SAML authentication response (assertion) issued by the SAML identity provider. The value contains 4 to 100,000 characters.

source_identity.description: The identity declared by the SourceIdentity attribute in the SAML assertion.

subject.description: The value of the NameID element of the Subject element in the SAML assertion.

subject_type.description: The format of the NameID, defined by the Format attribute of the NameID element in the SAML assertion.
